greet.speaker: Anxious Heir
greet.text: "Oh — are you here about the manor? My great-aunt's old place, west of here. I finally have to settle her estate, but every appraiser I've sent comes back pale and empty-handed. Lights moving on their own, they say."
greet.text_zh: 「喔——你是為了那棟宅邸來的嗎？我姨婆的老房子，就在西邊。我終於得處理她的遺產了，可是每個我派去的估價師回來都臉色發白，兩手空空。他們說裡面的燈會自己移動。」

backstory.speaker: Anxious Heir
backstory.text: "She was an alchemist. Brilliant, everyone said — and then she just... stopped seeing anyone, years before she died. Whatever she was working on at the end, she never finished it. Maybe that's why she won't leave."
backstory.text_zh: 「她是個煉金術師。大家都說她天資過人——但後來她就……不再見任何人了，在她過世前好幾年就是如此。不知道她臨終前在鑽研什麼，總之從未完成。也許這就是她放不下的原因。」

farewell.speaker: Anxious Heir
farewell.text: "Thank you. Whatever you find in there — I just want to know it's finally at rest."
farewell.text_zh: 「謝謝你。不管你在裡面發現什麼——我只希望知道它終於能安息了。」
